text:
amy_sales: Hi team, Acme's legal/regulatory lead (Carla) asked for the POC deliverables: completed CAIQ, executed EU SCCs (if possible), our DPA with deletion SLA, and confirmation that we don't use customer prompts to train models. They also asked whether they can trigger DSAR deletions from their end. Who can take the questionnaire and what are our standard answers?

rafael_se: I can fill out the CAIQ tech sections. Quick defaults for POC: Hosted API retains request/response payloads and request metadata (ip/app id) for 30 days by default; we keep encrypted backups for disaster recovery up to 120 days. Dedicated customers may enable "no retention" mode (suppress logs) and use BYOK or customer-managed keys. Private deployments are customer-controlled for retention.

carla_customer: Thanks Rafael. On DSARs: our privacy team prefers that we can call an API endpoint to delete a user's data automatically. Also they want a signed certificate of deletion for compliance.

maya_ops: We offer a bulk deletion endpoint for hosted customers and can generate a signed deletion report in response to a support request. Example for POC (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/customers/ACME-456/data/destroy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id":"u_1234","scope":["prompts","responses","session_meta"],"request_id":"req-abc-001"}'
```
Response: job id returned; typical hosted completion target 48-72 hours depending on dataset size. Backup purge schedule is separate and can take up to 120 days unless the customer requests an expedited backup purge (available as part of Dedicated SLA).

lucy_privacy: From the DPA/SCCs perspective: we support the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and will sign SCC Annex paperwork after contracting. Our DPA explicitly prohibits using customer prompts/outputs to train public models. We may use aggregated, de-identified telemetry for service improvements; customers can opt out of telemetry collection for Dedicated/Private. For certificate of deletion we provide a signed CSV containing deleted object keys and timestamps.

tom_account_exec: On the backups/subprocessor asks: enterprise buyers frequently push for <30 day backup retention and 30-day prior notice on subprocessors. Our standard is 120-day backup retention and 30-day notice for subprocessors. We can offer a 30-day backup retention on Dedicated with a commercial uplift. Oliver_legal (not on thread) can confirm margins but ballpark 10-20%.

carla_customer: Is there any scenario where Redwood could use our prompts to improve model weights? That's a hard no for us unless we opt in. Also, we need to know whether adding a new subprocessor would require our consent or just notice.

rafael_se: Short answer: no prompts/outputs used to train underlying public models under our standard DPA. Subprocessors: we notify customers 30 days in advance for new subprocessors; for subprocessors that materially change data residency or processing purpose we require written consent. We map subprocessors in the DPA Annex.

vendor-risk-bot: Vendor Risk ticket VR-2026-778 opened for Acme POC. Due date: 2026-06-10. Owners: rafael_se, lucy_privacy.

amy_sales: Next steps: Rafael assemble CAIQ answers + architecture diagram, Lucy prepare DPA + SCC Annex draft and the deletion certificate template, Maya prepare the deletion API docs and example signed report, Tom to model Dedicated uplift for 30-day backup purge. We'll bundle and send to Acme within 24h and schedule a 30-min walkthrough.

carla_customer: That plan works. One more ask: can you confirm whether telemetry used for quality improvements ever contain raw prompt content? If so we need opt-out controls.

lucy_privacy: Telemetry for QoS is aggregated metrics (latency, token counts) and sampling of anonymized traces. Raw prompt/response payloads are not included in aggregate telemetry. If a customer wants zero telemetry sampling we can disable it on Dedicated/Private.

maya_ops: FYI, there is a corner case: error-level traces may include a snippet of prompt for debugging; we redact PII by default and can disable retention of error payloads for Dedicated customers. We'll document this in the CAIQ control notes.

amy_sales: Perfect. Carla, we'll include a short appendix that explains telemetry sampling and the opt-out path. I'll schedule the walkthrough once packet is ready. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
